title: Protocol Emulator - Architecture-Independent Intent Schema
description: FROZEN INTERFACE between the behavioral reference model (Phase II) and the generic verification environment (Phase III). An intent states required pin-level behaviour in protocol terms only. It MUST NOT reference an instruction set, register map, CSR address, opcode, channel count, or a physical pin index. The role -> physical-pin binding is supplied per architecture by a swappable adapter ('intent compiler'), so this schema can remain unchanged across architecture candidates. Version 1.0.0 is the freeze point: additive change requires a MINOR bump, any semantic change requires a MAJOR bump and re-baselining of the generic testbench.

frozen.description: True once the generic testbench has been baselined against this schema version.

requires.description: Requirement IDs this intent exercises. All referenced requirements MUST pass the frozen-contract filter (see requirements/tools/select_contract.py).

roles.description: Abstract signal roles. Names are protocol-standard (tx, rx, sclk, mosi, ...), never physical pin indices.

resolution.description: Unit for all 'duration'/'within' fields in this intent. 'cycle' is expressed in system clock cycles at the architecture's clock; 'ns' is absolute time.

mode.description: Protocol-specific mode settings, e.g. {"cpol": 0, "cpha": 0} for SPI or {"data_bits": 8, "parity": "none", "stop_bits": 1} for UART.

within.description: Permitted deviation, in timing.resolution units, before the step is a failure.
